name: Orbit AI - Phase 2/Phase 9 - CX touch cadence

nodes.name: Every day at 8am
nodes.notes: 05 Section 9: 'CX touch cadence (7-day -> 30/60/90-day -> quarterly).' Unlike nurture-cadence.workflow.json's timing (a judgment call), this schedule's numbers ARE brief-given, verbatim.

nodes.name: Fetch LiveClient Companies
nodes.notes: Company, not Opportunity - post-sale CX activity belongs on the client-relationship object, same load-bearing distinction referral-trigger.workflow.json (W4.3) already follows.

nodes.name: Draft CX check-in

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-5', max_tokens: 512, system: [{ type: 'text', text: 'You draft short, warm post-sale check-in messages for existing clients (a value-driven touch, not a sales pitch). Reference how long they have been a client if it is meaningful. DRAFT ONLY for the account rep to review before sending - never implies it has been sent.', cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } }], messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Company: ' + $json.name + '
Client since: ' + $json.liveClientSince + '
CX wave: ' + $json.nextWave + ' (7/30/60/90-day then quarterly cadence)
Draft a check-in touch.' }] }) }}

nodes.notes: Draft only - same human-approves/sends rule as every other outbound-touch workflow in this repo.

nodes.name: Update Company CX state

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lastCxTouchAt: new Date().toISOString(), cxWave: $('Decide due touches').item.json.nextWave, lastCxDraftText: $json.draftText }) }}

nodes.notes: Same 'advances regardless of whether the rep actually sends it' reasoning as nurture-cadence.workflow.json.

nodes.name: Alert: CX draft ready

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'info', source: 'cx-cadence', message: 'CX check-in draft ready (wave ' + $('Decide due touches').item.json.nextWave + ') for ' + $('Decide due touches').item.json.name + '.', linkUrl: ($env.TWENTY_CRM_BASE_URL || '') + '/objects/company/' + $('Decide due touches').item.json.id }) }}

nodes.notes: Routes to #cx-retention (alertRouting.ts matches 'cx-' in the source string).
